tithe.law: FOUNDER LAW (Lane M rider, 2026-08-29): the Claude-agents API lane prices at PROVIDER COST BASIS + 10% TITHE in A — a distinct visible TITHE line on every receipt, never buried in the rate. The tithe percentage changes by founder word ALONE; rate_set versions track cost basis only. This number is law, not a parameter.

lanes.law: x402-RAID-Z33 (pinout compute/rates.json + lanePricing, read at source): a lane rate is COST BASIS x (1 + margin); in the estate the margin IS the 10% tithe and rides as its OWN line, never inside the rate. 1 credit = 1 second. A lane whose basis is unset or stale is NOT OFFERED (NotPriced) — the option disappears rather than mis-prices (the xorv stale-rate rule). Versions track cost basis only: no lane below carries a basis yet, so the version does not move.

compute_edge.note: the basis lands the day a citable per-second source exists (the lane-H service meters seconds; the A conversion rides the same seam as a_conversion_reference). Until then this lane is priced nowhere and offered nowhere.

free_qwen.tier: FREE (founder tier-ladder ruling, 2026-08-29): the box/qwen compute lane — guest keys, no charge, capped fairly (the Lane-H service caps are the fair cap)

prefill_token.note: local/qwen lane pricing is a later, separate founder question; free tier charges zero

decode_token.note: local/qwen lane pricing is a later, separate founder question; free tier charges zero

paid_claude.tier: PAID (founder tier-ladder ruling): the Claude-agents lane — A-metered at provider cost basis + the 10% tithe

cost_basis.note: Anthropic POSTED API pricing as the DISCLOSED REFERENCE BASIS while credits are unfunded (founder P3-GO option B). Receipts on this lane, when it opens, bill at these posted rates converted to A via the a_conversion_reference, plus THE TITHE (10%, separate line, founder law). Until the founder funds API credits the lane stays CLOSED — nothing bills.
cost_basis.basis: POSTED-REFERENCE (rate_set_ref carries this word — not a billed rate until the lane opens)

paid_claude.tithe_on_top: the 10% tithe is ON TOP of the anthropic bill, never inside it
